text: Residents of **New York City** are known as Knickerbockers, a nickname from Washington Irving's 1809 satire *A History of New York*, which was written under the pen name Diedrich Knickerbocker. The shared note's claim that the name began with Thames watermen in seventeenth-century England is not supported by the record, so I'm not relying on it. CONFIDENCE: 97
